# Formation v15 cyclic criticality x Wilson route frontier

Formation Polarization v15 supplies the exact mixed cyclic phase classifier for canonical common-centre amalgams.  For multiplier `C_n`, the object-level Fourier character group is `D_m ~= C_n`, while the formation compiler sees the reservoir/code state and the proper-factor generation number `rho in {1,2,infinity}`.  On a section-separated palette the complete arithmetic phase diagram is exact.  The all-distinct prime-power criticality and the universal noncritical branches used below do not depend on the unresolved cross-species unique-double exception.

Wilson Q192 has seven frozen route coordinates `(49,12,125,48,116,59,95)` with valencies `(30,60,60,60,60,60,60)`.  Every three-route subset generates the complete 152-dimensional Wilson commutant over `Q`.  Therefore any external cyclic formation controller whose nonzero support is coupled to a Wilson route triple has complete spatial linear equivariant closure.

For every prime power `n`, an all-distinct three-species canonical controller is formation-critical and has `n` object-level Fourier frequencies.  Choosing a cheapest Wilson triple containing route 49 gives route degree 150 and 1,108,800 directed edge visits on 7,392 states.  In particular the frequency-count comparison with the old binary Hamming controller is:

| frequencies | binary Hamming minimum degree | cyclic prime-power triple degree | saved |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2 | 150 | 150 | 0 |
| 4 | 270 | 150 | 120 |
| 8 | 330 | 150 | 180 |
| 16 | 390 | 150 | 240 |

Thus the old binary generalized-Hamming frontier is not a universal frequency/hardware lower bound.  It is the exact frontier only for the chosen `F_2^4` Hamming control layer.  A cyclic `C_4`, `C_8` or `C_16` controller has the same frequency *count* as 2-, 3- or 4-dimensional binary control but a different fusion group and can remain critical on three routes.

For `n=2^e`, `e>=2`, v15 adds three further unique-double critical controllers on each three-route support, at the same route degree and frequency count, provided the relevant palette is section-separated (or its Schur section-incidence category certifies the missing unit-reservoir obstruction).  Non-prime-power `n` has no critical canonical mixed controller; its state is one- or two-factor decomposable according to v15.

The identification of formation species with Wilson route coordinates is an engineering coupling.  No intrinsic finite-group identification between the two source constructions is claimed.
